name: web_search
what_it_does: Searches the internet for current information and returns page snippets and URLs.

example_input: current CEO of A.P. Moller - Maersk start date
example_output: [{'title': 'Executive Board - Maersk', 'snippet': 'Vincent Clerc is the CEO...', 'url': 'https://www.maersk.com/about/leadership'}]
